# Dangling test-name citations that ALREADY EXISTED when TestEveryNamedTestExists
# was written (M8-02 phase F). One name per line.
#
# THIS IS A .txt AND NOT A .go ON PURPOSE. The inventory used to be a map in a
# SCANNED _test.go file, so every entry CITED ITSELF on every run: the entry kept
# its own name 'live', the staleness check could never fire, and repairing a
# citation elsewhere produced no signal at all. A data file is not scanned, so an
# entry here is a claim about OTHER files and nothing else.
#
# It may only SHRINK: delete a name once it no longer dangles, and lower
# danglingBudget to match.
# ⚠️ 2026-08-17: this list GREW from 27 to 53, and the reason is a STRICTER CHECK,
# not new bad citations. The resolver used to accept ANY prefix match, which made
# the commonest rename (TestX -> TestX_v2) invisible; prefix matching is now limited
# to explicit family citations ending in "_". Tightening it revealed pre-existing
# truncated citations in other milestones' comments. None were introduced by the KEK
# rotation work and none are fixed by it — correcting each means deciding what it
# MEANT to cite, which is not this task's call. From here the list may only SHRINK.
# 2026-09-19: ONE entry added (53 -> 54), the sanctioned exception rather than rot.
# TestDriver_NoChangeKeyIsEverEmittedForApplicationKeyZero was RENAMED to
# TestDriver_ChangeKeyForApplicationKeyZeroIsEmittedLast when ADR 0017 section 5.1
# step 8 shipped (ADR 0018) -- the old name asserted the opposite of what the code now
# does. The old name is cited in IMMUTABLE ADR 0018, the M8 plan card, and the
# successor test's own explanatory comment (internal/encode/driver_test.go, which
# names what it replaced on purpose) -- the first two this task may not edit, so its
# citation cannot resolve regardless. danglingBudget was raised
# in the same change (visible in review), which is the mechanism's own rule for a
# justified growth.
# 2026-10-03: SIX entries added (54 -> 60), the same sanctioned exception as the
# 2026-09-19 one: tests REMOVED with the code they measured, cited by records this
# change may not rewrite. M10 OP-10 phase B removed the M7-06 panel's legal screen, its
# env allow-list and internal/domain/legal's write path (Store.Publish, the audit Trail):
# publishing moved to the platform operator's op_publish_legal (ADR 0020 §7). The four
# allow-list tests (TestOperatorGate_EmptyAllowListAdmitsNobody,
# TestOperatorGate_IsNotJoinableByRegisteringABusiness,
# TestOperatorGate_TheServerRefusesTheRouteItself,
# TestOperatorRefusal_ShowsTheCallerTheirOWNIdAndNobodyElses) measured a gate that no
# longer exists; TestNewStore_RefusesAMissingTrail and
# TestLegalDB_PublishWritesTheTextTheTrailAndTheSnapshotOrNoneOfThem measured a trail and
# a writer that no longer exist. They are cited by ADR 0016's body (immutable history:
# its OP-4 block says which sections were superseded), docs/plan/m7-portal.md (the M7-06
# record) and docs/plan/m10-platform.md (OP-4's and OP-10A's records, which name these
# tests as what B removes). danglingBudget was raised in the same change.
